cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — standing with one foot up on a step; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — folds a freshly washed sheet against her chest; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; a bridal room — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — sitting on the ground
